# doforme command reference

Plugin version: **0.29.0**.

| Command | Purpose | Agent | Input |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| /doforme:analyze | Investigate an issue by ID with automatically saved evidence | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
| /doforme:doctor | Check repository readiness without selecting an issue | guided coordinator | [advanced --input arguments for issue-specific preflight] |
| /doforme:endtoend | Guide an issue through the gated workflow to a local PR draft | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
| /doforme:fix | Review the exact scope and apply a saved repair plan | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
| /doforme:init | Guided repository setup with reviewed requirements and test discovery | guided coordinator | [guided setup; --inspect or --write for advanced helpers] |
| /doforme:plan | Prepare a repair plan from the saved issue investigation | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
| /doforme:pr | Prepare a local PR draft from the saved issue review | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
| /doforme:review | Review the saved issue evidence and scoped diff | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
| /doforme:status | List saved runs or show progress and the next step for one issue | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
| /doforme:test | Independently verify the saved issue fix | guided coordinator | [issue ID, #number, GitHub issue URL; advanced inputs also supported] |
